dataset.source: ERA5 reanalysis (ECMWF) daily aggregates via the Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
dataset.target: Daily clearness index Kt = Rs / Ra (Rs = shortwave radiation sum, MJ/m2/day)

network.optimizer: Adam (lr 0.002, cosine decay), batch 64, L2 0.00001, early stopping on the 2024 validation year
